components.gap: Define the event/distribution, logarithmic units and the entropy functional on its actual domain: Shannon's H=-K sum p_i log p_i with K>0 as the unit/base choice, the joint-event entropy of finite pairs, and the density functional for n-dimensional and joint densities with the integrability conditions under which -int p log p is finite, -infinity or undefined; the existing scattered finite definitions do not give the density functional's integrability domain or the multivariate/joint density case.

Present Shannon's characterization (Theorem 2: the only H continuous in the p_i, monotone increasing in n for equal p_i=1/n, and satisfying the decomposition-into-successive-choices rule is -K sum p_i log p_i, K>0) with the full Appendix 2 proof; and state and prove the finite joint/conditional properties: H=0 if and only if one p_i=1; conditional entropy H_x(y) as the probability-weighted average; the chain rule H(x,y)=H(x)+H_x(y); H(y)>=H_x(y); H(x,y)<=H(x)+H(y) with equality iff independence (present only as the Rissanen dependence identity, not in this method); and the doubly-stochastic averaging property that H increases except when the transformation is a permutation.

Present Shannon Section 20's continuous properties with integrability assumptions and proofs: maximum log v at the constant density on a volume v; H(x,y)<=H(x)+H(y) with equality iff independence a.e.; the averaging-kernel inequality; H(x,y)=H(x)+H_x(y)=H(y)+H_y(x) and H_x(y)<=H(y); the Gaussian maximum under fixed variance (and fixed n-dimensional second moments) with H=log(sqrt(2 pi e) sigma); the half-line fixed-mean exponential maximum log(ea); the Jacobian change-of-coordinates formula H(y)=H(x)-E log J; the linear case H(y)=H(x)+log|det a|; possible negativity; and invariance of entropy differences. The handbook has only a one-dimensional definition, a sentence that the reference coordinate matters, and a bounded-interval fixed-mean maximizer.

Separate statistical information amount from semantic truth, evidential support and decision value with an explicit justification and a worked contrast (equal-entropy messages or distributions differing in truth, support or decision value); only scattered remarks on maximum entropy's normative status and on one-step test selection exist.

Work a change-of-coordinates boundary for continuous entropy: compute a density's differential entropy in two coordinates, show the change equals the expected log-Jacobian, exhibit a negative value and show an entropy difference is invariant; and pair it with an explicit discrete dependence comparison computing H(x,y), H(x)+H(y) and H_x(y) for a dependent and an independent joint table under stated assumptions.
